title: The GojoHUB New  Script
features:
The GojoHUB New Doors Script is a powerful and feature-rich script menu designed for the Roblox game DOORS. With a clean and intuitive interface, it offers multiple categories like Doors, Items Mods, Rifts, Entity Spawner, and Other, making it a versatile tool for enhancing and customizing gameplay.
--------------------------------------------------------------------

Rusty Hotel – Teleports you to a rust-themed, alternate hotel environment.

Ranked Noob Achievement (Client Sided) – Grants a special achievement visible only on the client side.

Backdoors Helper – Assists with navigating or triggering backdoor mechanics.

Mischievous Portal – A mysterious portal that causes unexpected effects.

Magic Book – A magical item with unknown or powerful abilities.

Guiding Light Portal – Summons the Guiding Light to assist in your journey.

Doors X Grace – A crossover feature, likely referencing another character or game.

Doors Blackhole – Spawns a black hole with dramatic gameplay impact.

Old Hard Core – Activates a retro, more difficult version of DOORS.
---------------------------------------------------------------
This script is perfect for experienced players or developers who want to explore unique content, experiment with mods, or add new challenges to their DOORS gameplay.
